title: Final Condition
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly state the condition for non-vanishing scattering as the Bragg law equations for the lattice vectors.

title: Use of Born Approximation
description: Important Criteria: The student should demonstrate an understanding of the Born approximation in the context of scattering.

title: Integral Evaluation
description: Important Criteria: The student must show the evaluation of the integral involving the potential and the exponential term.

title: Lattice Points Sum
description: Important Criteria: The student should explain the significance of the sum over lattice points and its relation to the scattering condition.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as incorrect application of the exponential term or misinterpretation of the lattice vectors.
